Definition: to puff, in various applications (literally, to inflate, blow hard, scatter, kindle, expire; figuratively, to disesteem)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to breathe, blow, sniff at, seethe, give up or lose (life); 1a) (Qal) to breathe, blow; 1b) (Pual) to be blown; 1c) (Hiphil) to cause to breathe out
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
